title: [Main]-Import of e-documents with format ZUGfERD & XRECHNUNG fail with error message You cannot insert a purchase line without a purchase header in German localisation
summary: An earlier fix in the German XRechnung and ZUGFeRD import codeunits is reverted. The error 'You cannot insert a purchase line without a purchase header' is now handled by a separate change to Purchase Line and Sales Line in another PR.
key_points: Reverts a previous fix in the XRechnung and ZUGFeRD import codeunits of the German e-document app
The revert is done because Purchase Line and Sales Line were changed in another PR
Linked to the bug where these imports failed because a purchase line had no purchase header
quote: This pull requested is created to revert back the previous fix as Purchase and Sales Line is modified
